## FIX-0001

**Bugs:** [BUG-0001](bugs/dlc-builder.md#bug-0001)

**Root cause:** The writer emitted a single phraseIteration at the start beat; Rocksmith ends playback at the last phraseIteration.

**Solution:** The writer emits COUNT at the first beat, a default phrase at the first note and END past the last note's tail, and closes the sections with a 'noguitar' section.

| Components | src/rockforge/infrastructure/rsxml/writer.py |
| Tests | tests/test_rsxml_writer.py::test_phrase_structure_marks_song_end |
| Manual checks | — |
| Test result | passed |
| Validation | automated |
| Regression risk | Removing the END phrase brings the early song end back. |

## FIX-0002

**Bugs:** [BUG-0002](bugs/audio.md#bug-0002)

**Root cause:** The convert-external-source flow used a blank project's 'Vorbis Quality High' preset, which writes no seek table.

**Solution:** wwise.py extracts the vendored DLC Builder template project for the detected Wwise version, runs generate-soundbank and patches the header word at offset 40 to 3.

## FIX-0005

**Bugs:** [BUG-0005](bugs/sync.md#bug-0005)

**Root cause:** The offset was applied to both audio and score instead of aligning the score to the recording.

**Solution:** offset_s now means the second in the recording where the first note is heard; score and lyrics shift there and the audio is padded only up to MIN_LEAD_S.

## FIX-0042

**Bugs:** [BUG-0042](bugs/app.md#bug-0042)

**Root cause:** Browsers throttle or freeze a background tab's timers, so its 4 s heartbeats stopped and the watchdog treated 15 s of silence as a closed tab.

**Solution:** The tab reports itself hidden (POST /heartbeat?hidden=1), which suspends the idle kill; only /closing or the 30-minute safety net stop the server, and a poll gap over 5 s (system sleep) resets the clock.

## FIX-0109

**Bugs:** [BUG-0109](bugs/lyrics.md#bug-0109)

**Root cause:** A cuDNN/ctranslate2 native crash in the float16 GPU path with no fallback, no marker and no Demucs retry.

## FIX-0173

**Bugs:** [BUG-0173](bugs/import.md#bug-0173)

## FIX-0297

**Bugs:** [BUG-0297](bugs/editor.md#bug-0297)

**Root cause:** "Drag" is a sync tool (each drag is an anchor of the time warp), named and described like a note mover; "Edit notes" had no way to select and move several notes.

**Solution:** In Edit notes a drag on empty staff draws a selection box (a click still seeks) and dragging a selected note moves the whole selection as delete + insert note overrides (moveNotes): same time and string shift, may pass other notes, no sync anchor; a clash or a note outside the beat grid refuses it. Drag/Excerpt say they correct the timing, and a drag crossing the neighbouring correction warns and points at Edit notes.

## FIX-0351

**Bugs:** [BUG-0353](bugs/lyrics.md#bug-0353)

**Root cause:** songsterr_gp._lyrics took the first part with newLyrics as the part whose notes time the syllables, whatever instrument it was.

**Solution:** The lyrics are bound to a vocal part (GM voice program 52/53/54/85 or a voice-like name) when the tab has one, its own text first; the import warns when the text came in another part. fetch_tab also carries the track's instrumentId into the part.

## FIX-0352

**Bugs:** [BUG-0354](bugs/viewer.md#bug-0354)

**Root cause:** web/app.js wired #syncOffset on 'input' to setTrackStart, and updateSyncOffsetDisplay (from showArr) wrote toFixed(3) into the field even while it had the focus; type=number also refused a comma.

**Solution:** The field is a text input committed on Enter or blur (wireOffsetField); parseSeconds reads a comma or a dot and m:ss; arrow keys step 0.01/0.1/0.001 s; Esc restores; an invalid value toasts and restores; writeOffsetField never rewrites the field while it has the focus.

## FIX-0353

**Bugs:** [BUG-0355](bugs/lyrics.md#bug-0355)

**Root cause:** parser._lyric_notes and gpif_parser._lyric_notes appended a lyric note for every beat with notes, including beats whose notes are all tie destinations.

**Solution:** A beat whose notes are all ties (GP5 NoteType.tie, GPIF Tie destination="true") extends the previous lyric note's end instead of taking a syllable, in both parsers.

## FIX-0354

**Bugs:** [BUG-0356](bugs/viewer.md#bug-0356)

**Root cause:** web/app.js computed each tick's Karplus-Strong buffer on the main thread inside syncFrame when the note sounded (a held chord = several buffers of seconds each, cache missing on every new length), and MAX_TICKS_PER_FRAME (3) counted notes, so the rest of a chord's strings were skipped.

**Solution:** prewarmTicks hands the next 3 s of notes to a Blob worker running karplusSamples (the same DSP function as the on-the-spot fallback); the cache evicts least-recently-used; the per-frame cap counts attacks (notes within 30 ms are one).

## FIX-0356

**Bugs:** [BUG-0356](bugs/viewer.md#bug-0356)

**Root cause:** syncFrame started each tick at audioCtx.currentTime when a frame noticed the note had passed, so every tick was quantised to the frame and sounded up to a frame late (median 19 ms).

**Solution:** Ticks up to 0.12 s ahead are scheduled at their exact audio-context time (playNote's `when`); the backlog cap applies only to overdue notes; scheduled ticks not yet started are cancelled on pause, stopPlayback and every syncResetPointer.
